notes.title: Train Station Renovation Premiere - Buy now at a lower price [Livestream On]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/119f536804213637523ab010289d2971f7aa5ce6.png[/img]

[h2]Today, our good friends at Live Motion Games are releasing their full Train Station Renovation game![/h2]

A premiere livestream has been prepared especially for you on their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/914010/Train_Station_Renovation/]steam page[/url] and on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/livemotiongames]twitch.tv[/url]

[b]Additionally, each of you will get a 10% discount when purchasing the game at launch.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/0908a95d7ef57b3ecd9c4920393b33f7fbfc98ab.png[/img]


At the moment, there is a giveaway on the discord server in which you can win [b]20 keys[/b] to the [b]Train Station Ranovation[/b] game.
[url=https://discord.gg/CrfQyV9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

[i]Enter their chat and write that you are from us ;)[/i]

Best regards
Car Mechanic Simulator Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/914010/Train_Station_Renovation/
